page.overview:
Who is Flying Dragon Precious Staff?

The is a magic staff owned by the Bodhisattva Lingji.

Lingji was given the Flying Dragon Precious Staff, as well as the Wind-Arresting Pearl, by the Tathagata Buddha himself in order to combat the Yellow Wind Demon. When Tang Sanzang was kidnapped by the Yellow Wind Demon, Lingji used the staff to defeat the demon and transform him back into his true form, a yellow-furred mink.

When the Flying Demon Precious Staff is thrown and a spell is recited, it transform into a golden dragon with eight claws.

Category:Magical Treasures Category:Weapons Category:Dragons
